description: Create a daily or weekly goal, optionally linked to a task or project, with a checklist; shown in workload.zero as created by an agent. Example: title "Ship invoice export", checklist [{"label": "Write tests"}].

agentName.description: Who you are, shown in workload.zero as the creator, e.g. "Kampagnen-Agent Die Kette". Optional; without it the goal/task is still marked as agent-created.

checklist.description: Checklist items as an array, or a JSON string of that array (legacy)

name: create_goal
title: Create goal
